messages:
anna_ml: quick heads up — noticed promptset 'edgebank-v2' skews heavily toward transactional templates, causing a labeler bias in intent labels. would like a small triage + re-sample before we run quantization experiments.

kevin_labelops: ah ok. what's the failure mode? more duplicates or prompt framing causing mislabels?

anna_ml: framing. same intents but phrased with banking jargon -> labelers default to 'sensitive' intent. example:

kevin_labelops: can you paste examples?

anna_ml: "How do I dispute a charge on my premium checking?" vs "Charge dispute—premium acct" both meant same but labeler picks different subclass.

nora_dataeng: we can run a quick overlap de-dupe and cluster by semantic embedding then sample from clusters. should we exclude short-form titles?

sam_runtime: for the quant runs we need the golden to be stable. propose: create a 500-sample mini-golden focused on edgebank-v2, annotate with 3 labelers + arbiter, then block that set in the eval harness.

mike_qa: +1. timeline?

kevin_labelops: i can spin up a relabel task today. will use 3 labelers, conflict threshold 0.4, arbiter if disagree. need the sample list from dataeng.

nora_dataeng: extracting clusters now. will produce sample CSV and dedupe report. ps — found ~12% near-duplicates, and ~7% low-token titles that inflate sensitivity signals.

anna_ml: thanks. also flag: when we run quantized q4b models the confusion spike aligns with these edges. want to validate before we blame kernels.

sam_runtime: good call. after golden is locked, i'll run a small canary: quant4b/8bit on the mini-golden and post token-level diffs. can we add a soft-fallback in routing if regressions exceed 8%?

mike_qa: i'll prepare the eval script. maybe use this snippet for diff metrics:

```
python eval_diff.py --gold mini_golden.csv --pred preds.json --metrics accuracy,f1,slot_error
```

kevin_labelops: created task: https://tasks.internal/relab/9876 — assign labelers @lina, @omar, @felix

nora_dataeng: uploaded dedupe report: https://s3.redwood/edgebank/dedupe-1734567890.csv

anna_ml: awesome. once relabel finishes, let's do a brief triage meeting. 30m tomorrow? 10am PT works for me.

kevin_labelops: works for me :thumbsup:

sam_runtime: 10am PT on my calendar.

goldenbot: mini-golden set created (500 rows), id=mg-1734567890. locked for eval. use tag `mini_golden_edgebank_v1`.

anna_ml: perfect. thanks team — goal: either fix prompt sampling or annotate strong gold to isolate quant regressions.

mike_qa: noted. i'll wire up alerts for >8% drop across accuracy or >10% ~slot_error.

nora_dataeng: will also add a provenance flag for each sampled item so we can trace back ingestion pipeline.

kevin_labelops: will post updates in this thread when relabel completes.

anna_ml: cheers.
